Definition: a Shilonite or inhabitant of Shiloh
BiblicalUsage: Ahijah the Shilonite meets Jeroboam in the field and tears his garment into twelve pieces, and the men of the Shilonites are named among those who return to Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God raises a prophet from a small place, and Shiloh's name carries further than its walls.
